name: Ref Finance
rootCause: The NEAR ecological decentralized exchange Ref.Finance team tweeted that at around 2 pm UTC on August 14th, the Ref team noticed the abnormal behavior of the REF-NEAR trading pair, and then discovered that the patch of the recently deployed contract An error, which has been exploited by multiple users, affected approximately 1 million REFs and 580,000 NEARs.

descriptions.text: The NEAR ecological decentralized exchange Ref.Finance team tweeted that at around 2 pm UTC on August 14th, the Ref team noticed the abnormal behavior of the REF-NEAR trading pair, and then discovered that the patch of the recently deployed contract An error, which has been exploited by multiple users, affected approximately 1 million REFs and 580,000 NEARs.

Ref Finance on NEAR suffered an LP-accounting logic flaw after deploying a hotfix on 14 August 2021, allowing repeated unauthorized liquidity withdrawals. Up to $3.2 million was lost, with user balances reimbursed via DAO funds and a token fork restoring the pre-exploit state. A hotfix to the Ref Finance farming contract failed to debit LP token balances when users removed liquidity, allowing repeated withdrawal of pool assets against the same LP-token claim.
